Before you book

Is the minimum booking one hour?

Yes. Additional time can be calculated in quarter- or half-hour increments by agreement.

Is editing included?

You can receive organized raw footage or add editing and visual branding to the scope.

How do I book filming online?

Select “Book your filming online”, then log in or create an account. Choose a filming plan and session times, review the cost and payment instructions, attach the required transfer receipt and send your request.

Is my session confirmed when I submit the request?

No. Selected sessions are proposed until the team reviews the request and payment and approves the booking. You can track your request from your account.
